hook: An import is not a workflow run.
script:
Adding an import to a file does nothing on its own.

A workflow run needs a trigger, a runner and a result you can open.

Here is the commit that added the import. Here is the CI run it never triggered.

Check the Actions tab before you believe a green badge.
caption: An import is not a workflow run. Receipts in the pinned comment.
cta: Open your own Actions tab and count the runs.
visual_brief: Vertical 9:16. Split screen: the diff, then an empty Actions tab. Deep Muse Blue #0A2463 background.
